verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אַ֤ךְ אֱלֹהִ֗ים ט֭וֹב לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל לְבָרֵ֥י לֵבָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: miz·mō·wr lə·’ā·sāp̄ ’aḵ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ṭō·wḇ lə·yiś·rā·’êl lə·ḇā·rê lê·ḇāḇ
verses.literal: A Psalm of Asaph Surely God [is] good to Israel to those who are pure in heart

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֗י רַגְלָ֑י כִּ֭מְעַט נָטוּי אֲשֻׁרָֽי׃ כְּ֝אַ֗יִן שֻׁפְּכָה
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî raḡ·lāy kim·‘aṭ nå̄·ṭui ’ă·šu·rāy kə·’a·yin šup·pə·ḵå̄h
verses.literal: But as for me my feet had almost stumbled my steps had nearly slipped

verses.original: כִּֽי־ קִ֭נֵּאתִי בַּֽהוֹלְלִ֑ים אֶרְאֶֽה׃ שְׁל֖וֹם רְשָׁעִ֣ים
verses.literal: For I envied the arrogant [when] I saw the prosperity of the wicked

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֖ין חַרְצֻבּ֥וֹת לְמוֹתָ֗ם אוּלָֽם׃ וּבָרִ֥יא
verses.literal: - They have no struggle in their death their bodies are well-fed

verses.original: אֵינֵ֑מוֹ בַּעֲמַ֣ל אֱנ֣וֹשׁ לֹ֣א יְנֻגָּֽעוּ׃ וְעִם־ אָ֝דָ֗ם
verses.literal: They are free of the burdens others {carry} they are not afflicted like [other] men

verses.original: לָ֭כֵן גַאֲוָ֑ה עֲנָקַ֣תְמוֹ שִׁ֝֗ית חָמָ֥ס יַעֲטָף־ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ḡa·’ă·wāh ‘ă·nā·qaṯ·mōw šît̲ ḥā·mās ya·‘ă·ṭā·p̄ō·ši- lā·mōw
verses.literal: Therefore pride is their necklace a garment of violence covers them

verses.original: מֵחֵ֣לֶב יָ֭צָא עֵינֵ֑מוֹ מַשְׂכִּיּ֥וֹת לֵבָֽב׃ עָ֝בְר֗וּ
verses.literal: From their prosperity proceeds iniquity the imaginations of their hearts run wild

verses.original: יָמִ֤יקוּ׀ וִידַבְּר֣וּ בְרָ֣ע מִמָּר֥וֹם יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃ עֹ֑שֶׁק
verses.literal: They mock and speak with malice with arrogance they threaten oppression

verses.original: שַׁתּ֣וּ פִּיהֶ֑ם בַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וּ֝לְשׁוֹנָ֗ם תִּֽהֲלַ֥ךְ בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: šat·tū pî·hem ḇaš·šā·ma·yim ū·lə·šō·w·nām ti·hă·laḵ bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: They set their mouths against the heavens and their tongues strut across the earth

verses.original: לָכֵ֤ן׀ עַמּ֣וֹ יָשִׁיב הֲלֹ֑ם יִמָּ֥צוּ לָֽמוֹ׃ וּמֵ֥י מָ֝לֵ֗א
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ‘am·mōw yå̄·šīḇ hă·lōm yim·mā·ṣū lā·mōw ū·mê mā·lê
verses.literal: So their people return to this place and drink up waters in abundance

verses.original: וְֽאָמְר֗וּ אֵיכָ֥ה אֵ֑ל וְיֵ֖שׁ יָדַֽע־ בְעֶלְיֽוֹן׃ דֵּעָ֣ה
verses.literal: The wicked say How can God . . . know Does the Most High have knowledge

verses.original: הִנֵּה־ אֵ֥לֶּה רְשָׁעִ֑ים ע֝וֹלָ֗ם וְשַׁלְוֵ֥י הִשְׂגּוּ־ חָֽיִל׃
verses.literal: Behold these [are] the wicked always carefree as they increase their wealth

verses.original: אַךְ־ רִ֭יק זִכִּ֣יתִי לְבָבִ֑י בְּנִקָּי֣וֹן וָאֶרְחַ֖ץ כַּפָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ- rîq zik·kî·ṯî lə·ḇā·ḇî bə·niq·qā·yō·wn wā·’er·ḥaṣ kap·pāy
verses.literal: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure . . . in innocence I have washed my hands

verses.original: וָאֱהִ֣י נָ֭גוּעַ כָּל־ הַיּ֑וֹם וְ֝תוֹכַחְתִּ֗י לַבְּקָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ĕ·hî nā·ḡū·a‘ kāl- hay·yō·wm wə·ṯō·w·ḵaḥ·tî lab·bə·qā·rîm
verses.literal: For I am afflicted all day long . . . and punished every morning . . .

verses.original: אִם־ אָ֭מַרְתִּי אֲסַפְּרָ֥ה כְמ֑וֹ הִנֵּ֤ה בָגָֽדְתִּי׃ ד֭וֹר בָּנֶ֣יךָ
verses.literal: If I had said I will speak this way then I would have betrayed vvv Your children

verses.original: וָֽ֭אֲחַשְּׁבָה לָדַ֣עַת זֹ֑את הִיא עָמָ֖ל בְעֵינָֽי׃
verses.literal: When I tried to understand all this it was troublesome in my sight

verses.original: עַד־ אָ֭בוֹא אֶל־ אֵ֑ל מִקְדְּשֵׁי־ אָ֝בִ֗ינָה לְאַחֲרִיתָֽם׃
verses.literal: until I entered . . . God’s sanctuary then I discerned their end

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ תָּשִׁ֣ית לָ֑מוֹ בַּ֭חֲלָקוֹת הִ֝פַּלְתָּ֗ם לְמַשּׁוּאֽוֹת׃
verses.literal: Surely You set them on slick ground You cast them down into ruin

verses.original: אֵ֤יךְ כְרָ֑גַע הָי֣וּ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה תַ֝֗מּוּ סָ֥פוּ מִן־ בַּלָּהֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ’êḵ ḵə·rā·ḡa‘ hā·yū lə·šam·māh ṯam·mū sā·p̄ū min- bal·lā·hō·wṯ
verses.literal: How suddenly they are laid waste completely swept away by terrors

verses.original: מֵהָקִ֑יץ כַּחֲל֥וֹם אֲ֝דֹנָי בָּעִ֤יר׀ תִּבְזֶֽה׃ צַלְמָ֬ם
verses.literal: Like [one] waking from a dream so You, O Lord awaken [and] despise their form

verses.original: כִּ֭י לְבָבִ֑י יִתְחַמֵּ֣ץ אֶשְׁתּוֹנָֽן׃ וְ֝כִלְיוֹתַ֗י
verses.literal: When my heart was grieved and I was pierced within

verses.original: וַאֲנִי־ בַ֭עַר וְלֹ֣א אֵדָ֑ע הָיִ֥יתִי בְּ֝הֵמ֗וֹת עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.literal: I was senseless and ignorant I was a brute beast before You

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י תָמִ֣יד עִמָּ֑ךְ אָ֝חַ֗זְתָּ יְמִינִֽי׃ בְּיַד־
verses.literal: Yet I am always with You You hold my right hand

verses.original: תַנְחֵ֑נִי בַּעֲצָתְךָ֥ וְ֝אַחַ֗ר תִּקָּחֵֽנִי׃ כָּב֥וֹד
verses.literal: You guide me with Your counsel and later receive me in glory

verses.original: מִי־ לִ֥י בַשָּׁמָ֑יִם בָאָֽרֶץ׃ חָפַ֥צְתִּי לֹא־ וְ֝עִמְּךָ֗
verses.transliteration: mî- lî ḇaš·šā·mā·yim ḇā·’ā·reṣ ḥā·p̄aṣ·tî lō- wə·‘im·mə·ḵā
verses.literal: Whom have I in heaven but You And on earth I desire no one besides You

verses.original: שְׁאֵרִ֗י וּלְבָ֫בִ֥י כָּלָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֥ים צוּר־ לְבָבִ֥י וְחֶלְקִ֗י לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šə·’ê·rî ū·lə·ḇā·ḇî kā·lāh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ṣūr- lə·ḇā·ḇî wə·ḥel·qî lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: My flesh and my heart may fail but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever

verses.original: רְחֵקֶ֣יךָ כִּֽי־ הִנֵּ֣ה יֹאבֵ֑דוּ הִ֝צְמַ֗תָּה כָּל־ זוֹנֶ֥ה מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: rə·ḥê·qe·ḵā kî- hin·nêh yō·ḇê·ḏū hiṣ·mat·tāh kāl- zō·w·neh mim·me·kā
verses.literal: Those far from You will surely perish You destroy all who are unfaithful to You

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י׀ לִ֫י־ ט֥וֹב קִֽרֲבַ֥ת אֱלֹהִ֗ים שַׁתִּ֤י׀ בַּאדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֣ה מַחְסִ֑י לְ֝סַפֵּ֗ר כָּל־ מַלְאֲכוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî lî- ṭō·wḇ qi·ră·ḇaṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm šat·tî ba·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh maḥ·sî lə·sap·pêr kāl- mal·’ă·ḵō·w·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: But as for me [it is] good to draw near to God I have made the Lord GOD my refuge that I may proclaim all Your works
